data.reasoning: The disagreement is caused by a tool error (HTTP 400 API failure) in the qwen model during the full PKGBUILD review, not by a difference in security analysis. Both models' initial assessments and the deepseek model's full review correctly identified the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO as standard, safe packaging with no malicious code.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an LLM API error (HTTP 400) when attempting the full review of the PKGBUILD, forcing an 'inconclusive' result. The deepseek model completed the review successfully and found the package safe. The initial safety gate pass by qwen also found the PKGBUILD safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete the full PKGBUILD review due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient errors (like HTTP 400) from resulting in inconclusive security verdicts.
